name: comp-275
blurb: Inline warning alert with action link.
description: Warning alert with inline text and an action link. Allows users to take immediate action in response to the warning without leaving the context.
use_when: Showing warnings with an associated action, like 'Learn more' or 'Fix now' links.
avoid_when: When action should be in a separate button. Dense layouts with multiple alerts.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Links are keyboard accessible but alert not announced to screen readers. Parent should add role='alert' and aria-live.
